title: Bay Kafan Janazeyan Saf Ban Laee Lakh Rokeya Naizeyaan Teeraan
body:
Sajjad Perhaawan Aaya Ey Babay Diyan Panj Takbiraan
<<DIVIDER>>
Pehli Takbir Janazay Di Kuj Hamd Hoi Kuj Vayn Ey
Sajjad Keya Mabood Tere Is Abdd Da Naam Hussain Ey
Tu Wahadaahu Tay Hogaya Eyn Eydi Lutiyaan Kul Jageeraan
<<DIVIDER>>
Duji Takbirich Abid Nay Keya Lay Nanay Da Naam Ey
Sumaan Nal Ker Pamaal Gaey Rehvaar Durood Salaam Ey
Mein Khaaq Chon Chun Chun Joriyaan Nay Rehmat Diyaan Ey Tasveeraan
<<DIVIDER>>
Teeji Takbir Keya Abid Dasan Qudrat Bhen Bhera Di
Shah Oniyaan Laashan Chukiyaan Nay Roee Zainab Oni Waari
Jiniyaan Tataheer Di Chader Tay Nay Lau Di Paak Lakeeraan
<<DIVIDER>>
Chothi Takbir Gawahi See Eythay Aan Kay Abid Roya
Keya Maalik Aey Kam Zainab Tay Kulsoom Day Zimmay Hoya
Hun Jaa Kay Gawaaiyaan Dayn Giaan Vich Shaam Eydi Hamsheeraan
<<DIVIDER>>
Panjwi Takbir Ton Baad Akbar Ey Keh Maiyat Dafnaaee
Kisay Zaalim Ik Anguthi Laee Os Hath Di Ungli Laaee
Jis Hath Naal Babay Likhiyaan San Duniya Diyaan Kul Taqdeeraan
